mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals a supply shock that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines > 1% MoM but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will negatively impact equity valuations and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and UNRATE rising
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising by more than 3% year-over-year, it signals an inflationary environment that will negatively impact real equity returns and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) declines by more than 100,000 jobs month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6%, it signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) decline by more than 2% month-over-month and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising by more than 2% year-over-year, it signals a demand shock that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines > 2% MoM and CPIAUCSL rising > 2% YoY
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
